acceptance: A generated bundle includes `_sources/tpc-ds/EULA.txt` when TPC-DS query templates are referenced and `_sources/tpc-h/EULA.txt` when TPC-H query templates are referenced.
Tests prove both sidecars are included only as companions to corresponding template downloads.
The site builds from the generated bundle and publishes the correct `TPC_EULA.txt` beside both TPC-H and TPC-DS downloads.
The bounded site-inputs tests and bundle verification pass.
context: Discovered while replaying core #2891/#2893 to site. Bundle run 38087375221 for core `4628e72d66bcc77808b59740b9d8d0c777e2d2f7` does not contain `_sources/tpc-ds/EULA.txt` or `_sources/tpc-h/EULA.txt`; local site build fails with `TPC EULA is missing` at `website/src/lib/legacy-assets.ts`. Current core scripts/site_inputs.py builds `downloads/` from directly linked paths only.
description: The site replay of the core EULA-download changes requires `_sources/tpc-ds/EULA.txt` and `_sources/tpc-h/EULA.txt` beside downloadable query templates. The certified site bundle currently copies only document-linked files, so the site build fails when it tries to publish these companion licenses. Extend site-inputs download selection to include the matching TPC EULA when a TPC-DS or TPC-H query template is included. Keep the bundle limited to referenced downloads plus their required license sidecars; do not copy unrelated files. Preserve bundle attestations and generated paths.
